bccd9da27047.what: The Planning Board's article would replace the zoning bylaw's accessory apartment section with rules for accessory dwelling units (ADUs). A Protected Use ADU, allowed by right under state law, could be up to half the main home's floor area or 900 square feet, whichever is smaller, with a Building Department permit. A Large Accessory Dwelling Unit (LADU) of up to 1,200 square feet would need a special permit. One ADU is allowed per lot, and either kind may be a short-term rental if the owner lives on the property. The Finance and Warrant Advisory Committee voted 7-0 and the Planning Board 5-0-0 to recommend it.
bccd9da27047.history: The Planning Board had a minor adjustment to the proposed ADU article on its Sep 14 agenda.

a4ba3b203a9f.what: Maureen Pollock, the planning director, briefs the Selectboard on the state's new consolidated local permitting process for small clean energy projects (225 CMR 29.00). Under the 2024 Climate Act, towns must decide a complete application within 12 months with all local permits reviewed together; if no decision is issued the project is approved by default, and appeals go to the state Energy Facilities Siting Board.

a4ba3b203a9f.how_to_speak: Public comment period at 6:00 PM; individuals are limited to two minutes each.

a4ba3b203a9f.when_time: Monday, October 19, 2026, item at 6:25 (topics may start earlier than specified)

869d33654c02.how_to_speak: Public comment period at 6:00 PM; individuals are limited to two minutes each.

869d33654c02.when_time: Monday, October 19, 2026, item at 6:25 (topics may start earlier than specified)

378a45eb70db.history: The company filed its wetlands notice with the state Aug 17 (fee paid by New Leaf Energy). First time before the Commission.
378a45eb70db.how_to_speak: Public hearing; the notice says all interested parties are invited to attend.
378a45eb70db.line: Floating solar farm with batteries off Golden Pond Rd: Carver wetlands hearing
378a45eb70db.quote: Notice of Intent submitted by Golden Pond Solar 1, LLC, to construct a floating solar photovoltaic system on a humanmade reservoir with coupled battery storage, associated site work, and interconnection within the 200-foot Riverfront Area, in the 65-foot Buffer Zone to Bordering Vegetated Wetland (BVW) consisting of cranberry bogs, and in the 100-foot Buffer Zone to BVW.
